title: Dependent finite mixed Nash equilibria in Lean
summary: A Lean-native formalization of finite mixed Nash equilibrium for games in which each player has its own finite, nonempty action type. The library defines dependent profiles and finite expected payoffs, proves support equalization and Dirac transport, establishes the closed/compact/convex mixed-profile geometry, and connects the normalized excess map to a checked product-of-simplices Brouwer theorem.
